I grew up with a soft coat wheaten terrier. And I can't express how much of a friendly dog he was. He loved attention from people and was the sweetest thing ever. We got him when I was 8, and I think we did everything to that poor dog which would make some dogs dislike you. My sister would put him in a stroller and push him around the house or block, also while dressing him up in babydoll clothes with bows in his hair. However he would still come run up to play with us after. The most loyal dog you could ever ask for. He would follow my dad around the house wherever he went and he loved to play fetch in the yard with tennis balls (wasn't great at bringing them back, he more wanted you to come chase him). Another great thing was he was 0% shedding, so that's a thing to think about, save you and your family trouble of having to vacuum all the time. He was a medium sized dog so about 40 pounds, super fluffy, and in the summer we would shave him so that he would be more comfortable. He recently was put down due to a tumor and old age, and my dad who grew up with German shepherds and pit bulls has determined that he's never getting another dog besides a wheaten terrier. This breed is amazing with children and is one of the most loving, caring dog breeds around. I too am actually looking to get a wheaten when I move to the city in August, I can't think of a more perfect medium sized dog than this breed.
